name: oxlint-plugin-anti-slop
description: Opinionated Oxlint rules that reject low-evidence TypeScript and JavaScript patterns.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:skill-assets
scripts.test: tsx src/rules/no-conditional-empty-object-spread.test.ts && tsx src/rules/no-unsafe-dictionary-type.test.ts && tsx src/rules/no-known-value-widening.test.ts && tsx src/rules/no-object-parameters.test.ts && tsx src/rules/no-self-licking.test.ts && tsx src/rules/no-fraud.test.ts
